critique.evidence: Cohesive dark command-center styling, restrained cyan/red accents, strong headline, and consistent card treatment create a credible visual identity across viewports. However, chart typography is extremely small, the precision–recall x-axis repeats “100%” and ends at “65%,” dense mobile tables become cramped cardlets, and low-contrast secondary copy weakens legibility. Desktop composition leaves excessive empty space above and beside the intro, while tablet/mobile headers visibly truncate navigation and the mobile header loses the brand label, making the system feel clipped rather than intentionally responsive.
critique.fix: Correct and simplify chart ticks, raise secondary-text contrast and minimum type size, redesign the mobile ablation content as a clearer comparison stack, tighten desktop hero spacing, and give tablet/mobile navigation a deliberate collapsed pattern with persistent branding and an obvious current-section state.
